{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Read the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Clean revenue: remove commas and convert to float
df['revenue_clean'] = df['revenue'].str.replace(',', '', regex=False).astype(float)

# Check for QA orders (documented as 999999.99)
qa_orders = df[df['revenue_clean'] == 999999.99]
print("Number of QA orders:", len(qa_orders))

# Check if any QA orders are in `completed` status
print("QA orders with status 'completed':", qa_orders['status'].eq('completed').sum())"}
